name: orbit-gallery
title: Orbit Gallery
author: AlgorizeTech
description: A two-column hero with a ring of photo cards revolving on the right, each card staying upright as it travels. Hovering the ring holds it still; moving the pointer over the section leaves a trail of dots in the accent colour. Use it for an agency, studio or gallery.
docs: Named export: OrbitGallery. Pass `badgeText`/`badgeHref`, `title` and `titleAccent`, `subtitle`, primary and secondary actions, `images` (any count — they space themselves evenly), `duration` in seconds for one revolution and `highlights` for the dotted facts row. `color` is a preset name or any CSS colour; `linkComponent` takes next/link.
